summary: Capitalises the first letter of every word and lowers the rest.
description: Word boundaries are those of a regular expression, so `"hello WORLD"` becomes `"Hello World"`. Punctuation and separators are left exactly where they were.

params.value: The string to convert. It must not be empty.
params.options: `trim` trims the string and collapses runs of whitespace into single spaces.

throws.EmptyStringException: the value is not a string, or is empty.
